e.title: Economic Scenario Generator (Python)
e.summary: 开源经济情景生成器：风险中性/真实世界情景模拟，Solvency II/IFRS 17 负债估值
e.body: Economic-Scenario-Generator-in-Python（SerigneCisse）是开源 ESG：利率/股票/通胀等资产的随机模拟框架，生成风险中性（定价）与真实世界（资本）情景，用于保险负债估值与 Solvency II/IFRS 17 合规。对 RIAA：偿付能力/IFRS 17 估值链路的稀缺开源环节——情景生成是随机准备金与资本模型的输入（同 [[gemact]] 模拟谱系）；与 [[ifrs17a]]（IFRS 17 计量）、[[climada]]（气候情景）配合构成情景化建模全链路；对应 [[rim540]]（IFRS 17）实务场景。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：GitHub 确认（风险中性/真实世界 ESG、Solvency II/IFRS 17），未实测
e.summary_en: Open-source economic scenario generator: risk-neutral/real-world scenario simulation for Solvency II/IFRS 17 liability valuation
e.summary_hk: 開源經濟情景生成器：風險中性/真實世界情景模擬，Solvency II/IFRS 17 負債估值
e.body_en: Economic-Scenario-Generator-in-Python (SerigneCisse) is an open-source ESG: a stochastic simulation framework for rates/equities/inflation that generates risk-neutral (pricing) and real-world (capital) scenarios for insurance-liability valuation and Solvency II/IFRS 17 compliance. For RIAA: a rare open-source link in the solvency/IFRS 17 valuation chain — scenario generation feeds stochastic reserving and capital models (the simulation lineage of [[gemact]]); with [[ifrs17a]] (IFRS 17 measurement) and [[climada]] (climate scenarios) it completes the scenario-based modelling chain; maps to the [[rim540]] (IFRS 17) practical context.
e.body_hk: Economic-Scenario-Generator-in-Python（SerigneCisse）是開源 ESG：利率/股票/通脹等資產的隨機模擬框架，生成風險中性（定價）與真實世界（資本）情景，用於保險負債估值與 Solvency II/IFRS 17 合規。對 RIAA：償付能力/IFRS 17 估值鏈路的稀缺開源環節——情景生成是隨機準備金與資本模型的輸入（同 [[gemact]] 模擬譜系）；與 [[ifrs17a]]（IFRS 17 計量）、[[climada]]（氣候情景）配合構成情景化建模全鏈路；對應 [[rim540]]（IFRS 17）實務場景。
